title: T-Retrievability: A Topic-Focused Approach to Measure Fair Document Exposure in Information Retrieval

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring disparities in document accessibility across different retrieval models by computing T-Retrievability scores. The methodology involves grouping topically-related real-world user queries via K-means clustering (using sparse or dense embeddings), calculating the expected reciprocal rank of retrieved documents for these groups, and applying the Gini coefficient to quantify the fairness of document exposure.
